name: dreamlab-txbt4
comment: DreamLab sidechain beside BLAKE2b testnet4 (txbt4), sealed 2026-10-02 for the agent-payments demo (owner decisions SC1, SC2; agentbox ADR-2103). Research stage: level 1, one signer, depth 0. Coins carry no value. NOT ANCHORED at the seal: no checkpoint is written into txbt4 (owner SC5, cost), so until checkpoints are switched on a block is the single signer's word; the producer's /tip and checkpoints.json say whether any checkpoint exists. Mainnet parents are behind the P21 owner-and-legal gate.
